stem: Two irrigation zones use the same media and receive the same event volume, but one zone now dries back much faster after a sustained increase in light and air movement. What is the best management response?
choices: Keep both schedules identical because equal media requires equal irrigation
Raise fertilizer concentration in the faster-drying zone
Reduce air movement until both zones dry at the same rate
Reassess irrigation timing against measured depletion and current environmental demand rather than assuming the original schedule remains appropriate
rationale: Water demand can change with environmental conditions even when media and programmed event volume are unchanged. Irrigation timing should respond to measured root-zone depletion and current crop demand.
